# EGO POWER+ WDV0904 — 9 Gallon Cordless Wet/Dry Vacuum (Kit)

**Category:** Shop Vacuum (Cordless Wet/Dry)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Model / variant | WDV0904 (kit); WDV0900 is the tool-only variant |
| Battery platform | EGO POWER+ 56V ARC Lithium™ (compatible with all EGO 56V batteries) |
| Included battery | 56V 5.0Ah ARC Lithium™ |
| Included charger | 320W (CH3200) |
| Motor | Brushless |
| Airflow | Up to 110 CFM |
| Water lift | 100 in |
| Tank capacity | 9 gal, with drain plug |
| Power modes | Low/ECO, High, Turbo — selectable onboard or via wireless remote |
| Runtime (5.0Ah) | Up to 60 min ECO / 30 min High / 20 min Turbo |
| Hose | 1-7/8 in diameter (7 ft replacement hose available, AVH0907) |
| Filter | Cartridge filter with onboard filter-cleaning function; replacement AVF0900 traps particles down to 0.5 micron |
| Dust bags | Optional 5-pack AVG0905 |
| Storage | Onboard storage for nozzles, extension tubes, and hose |
| Included accessories | 2 extension tubes, crevice nozzle, round brush dust nozzle, large floor nozzle with brush bar, rubber bar, compact floor nozzle, 1-7/8" hose, wireless remote, remote charging cable, power tool adapter |
| Warranty | 5-year limited tool; 3-year limited battery/charger |
| Documentation | [Manual (PDF)](https://egopowerplus.com/mpattachment/file/download/id/3295/) · [Parts list (PDF)](https://egopowerplus.com/mpattachment/file/download/id/3331/) |

## Notable Features

- EGO bills it as the most powerful cordless wet/dry vac on the market: 110 CFM and 100-inch water lift from a brushless motor.
- Hose-mountable wireless remote lets you switch power modes without walking back to the canister.
- Filter-cleaning function maintains suction as the 9-gallon tank fills; drain plug for emptying liquids.
- Full onboard storage for every included nozzle, tube, and the hose.
- Power tool adapter included for dust-extraction use with tools.
- Same 56V battery ecosystem as EGO's outdoor equipment, so the included 5.0Ah pack and 320W charger are shared with mowers, trimmers, etc.
- Manufacturer page currently shows "Coming Soon" with no published price.
